intro.text: One of the largest plateaus on the Shattered Plains, and the furthest east the Alethi armies have found.

description.text: The Tower is oddly shaped and unusually massive, and chasmfiends often come to it to pupate.

title.text: The war on the Shattered Plains

items.text: The Alethi highprinces had fought for the Tower twenty-nine times without winning a single skirmish there; Dalinar had lost twice on his own and once in a joint attack with Sadeas.
